raw.title: Sengzhao
raw.extract: Sengzhao was a Chinese Buddhist philosopher from Later Qin. Born to a poor family in Jingzhao, he acquired literary skills and became a scribe. This exposed him to a variety of uncommon documents. He was influenced by the Taoists Laozi and Zhuangzi, and although we are told he enjoyed Laozi’s Daodejing, he was overjoyed when he discovered the Vimalakīirti Sūtra. This encounter transformed his life and he became a Buddhist. He was known as being among the ablest of the disciples of Kumārajīva.
